incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: `PD-8931` fired for small-inference-latency-surge in us-west-2 - urgency: low
PD Bot: Incident triggered: `small-inference-latency-surge` (service: runtime-router). Escalation policy: oncall-night -> secondary.
Sam: acked. I'm on it, pulling up dashboards now. :eyes:
Priya: thx. any customer impact flagged?
Sam: not seeing 5xxs. p50/p95 for short sequences spiked ~200ms -> 600ms for ~2m. traffic normal. looks like transient KV cache churn.
Marta: I see a brief rotator metric bump on route `gen-fast` at 03:14:23 UTC. Could be an autoscaler flapping or a tiny rollout.
Sam: noted. running `kubectl get hpa -n runtime` to see if pods scaled weirdly
Sam: ```
# kubectl get hpa -n runtime
NAME            REFERENCE             TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
runtime-hpa     Deployment/runtime     60%/80%   2         10        6
```
Priya: hm HPA looks fine. can you check model-serving logs around 03:14? maybe a GC or coldstart on a subset of hosts.
Sam: grabbing logs from host i-0a12...: ```
[03:14:20] INFO kv_cache: eviction sweep started
[03:14:21] WARN runtime: small model shard reload triggered
[03:14:22] INFO runtime: shard ready (warmup 1.2s)
[03:14:23] ERROR runtime: transient backend latency 450ms
```
Marta: that lines up. small shard reload + eviction -> some requests hit cold path.
Nate: no PagerDuty escalations yet? PD Bot shows auto-escalation window 5m.
PD Bot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 5m unless acknowledged by next level.
Sam: plan: pin route to shard-stable-1 for a short window, trigger targeted prewarm on 3 allocs, and lift route back after 2m. Priya can you approve route pin?
Priya: approve. do it.
Sam: executing route pin -> `redwood route set --route gen-fast --pool shard-stable-1 --ttl 120s`
Sam: triggering prewarm: ```
redwood prewarm --shard shard-stable-1 --concurrency 3 --model small-enc
```
Marta: prewarm jobs started. watching tail of latency.
Sam: latency down to p95 240ms within 40s. p50 back to normal.
Nate: customer impact: none reported to support, no active error reports.
PD Bot: PD-8931 still open. No escalation performed.
Sam: leaving note and unpin after 2m. will monitor for 10m then close.
Priya: thanks. quick postmortem note: transient KV eviction triggered shard reloads during a small overlapping rollout. action: add jitter to eviction sweep and make shard reloads rate-limited.
Marta: filing a follow-up ticket: INF-1427 (add jitter and rate-limit shard reload). I'll add logs and timeline.
PD Bot: PD-8931 resolved by user Sam at 03:18:02 UTC (auto-resolve: true)
incident-bot: This thread has been marked resolved. If new alerts surface, a new PD incident will be created. :white_check_mark:
